item.title: Top 5 Methods to Retrieve a List of Tasks in Celery Queues
item.description:
When dealing with Celery queues, developers often find the need to efficiently retrieve a list of tasks that are yet to be processed. Understanding how to do this can significantly ease task management in a distributed system. Below are several approaches to accomplishing this based on different broker systems, specifically focusing on Celery’s integration with RabbitMQ and Redis.
